title: Santa Barbara Sportfishing Charters

services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: You’ll be both proud and safe when you climb on board Santa Barbara Sportfishing’s wonderful boat. We call her “Loose Cannon” and she is a great charter fishing boat. In 2019, Tony flew out to New England to check out a special boat. She is a 2018 Calvin Beal 36. If she looks like a real fishing boat it is because she is and her Maine heritage is evident. Loose Cannon, as she is fondly named, caught Tony’s heart and soon she was being transported form the East Coast to the West. We think she is pretty darn happy cruising the coastal waters and docked in the Santa Barbara Harbor. Captain Tony takes your safety and security very seriously. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Imagine being on the water. On one side are the Channel Islands, on the other the gorgeous Santa Barbara coastline. In just a matter of minutes, the sun will set, producing a rainbow of colors in the sky. A sunset cruise with Captain Tony will take away all your stress, leaving you and your friends happy, relaxed and so satisfied. For many years, Captain Tony has been delighting people with fishing trips, sunset cruises, Island Adventures, and more. He is a seasoned Captain who is committed to your safety and delight.
